title: Copilot Notebooks: audio overview gains topic episodes, Critique and Debate formats and label support
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and existing Notebooks controls are supported, and it distinguishes conflicting Microsoft documentation rather than presenting either version as settled. The Graph control note should name the request-body properties explicitly; no blocking correction was found.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft 365 Apps admin center path reaches Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Select Customization from the left pane. Select Policy Management. Create a new policy configuration or edit an existing one. From the Choose the scope dropdown list ... In Configure Settings ... Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can apply the Notebooks setting through a preview applyOnce baseline.
claims.quote: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors ... mode ... The possible values are: monitorOnly, applyOnce, unknownFutureValue.
claims.fix: In controls[0].note and the rendered row note, replace 'API: preview TCM applyOnce, resourceType microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, value 0 or 1.' with 'API: preview TCM; request body sets mode to applyOnce and baseline.resources[].resourceType to microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, resourceVersion to 1, and properties.value to the string 0 (disable) or 1 (enable).' Keep the call unchanged. References: https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/configurationmanagement-post-configurationmonitors?view=graph-rest-beta and https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy can scope the Notebooks setting to the whole tenant or a group.
claims.quote: From the Choose the scope dropdown list, choose either All users or select the group for which you want to apply the policy.

claims.claim: An applyOnce configuration monitor applies a desired-state baseline once.
claims.quote: An active applyOnce monitor runs in the background on behalf of the signed-in administrator and then becomes inactive.

claims.claim: The baseline resource type for this setting is microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks.
claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks"

claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks", "resourceVersion": 1

claims.claim: The setting is written through properties.value, a string with 0 meaning disable and 1 meaning enable.
claims.quote: value | Write | String ... 0 disables the setting; 1 enables the setting. ... "properties": { "value": "1" }

claims.claim: TCM supports the Copilot Cloud Policy settings only in tenant-level policies.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: TCM operations fail for a resource whose target setting is configured in a group-level policy.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.claim: AI Administrator is the least-privileged signed-in user role for TCM applyOnce on this resource.
claims.quote: For remediation and applyOnce, AI Administrator is the least-privileged Microsoft Entra role for the signed-in user. This role requirement applies to the user, not to the TCM service principal.

claims.claim: The calling app needs delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All permission for applyOnce.
claims.quote: Creating an applyOnce monitor supports delegated permissions only. In addition to the calling app's delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All permission, the TCM service principal needs delegated permissions for the target workloads

claims.claim: The TCM service principal needs delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite permission.
claims.quote: Delegated permissions ... Remediation and applyOnce | CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite

claims.claim: The TCM mechanism and Microsoft Graph beta API are preview capabilities.
claims.quote: This article lists the Copilot resource types supported in preview for monitoring and snapshots through the Tenant Configuration Management (TCM) APIs in Microsoft Graph beta. These resources also support remediation and applyOnce.

claims.claim: The existing Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks policy defaults to Enabled.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation | Cloud Policy: Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks | Enabled

claims.claim: Disabling the policy prevents users from creating new Notebooks.
claims.quote: When creation is disabled, users are unable to create new Copilot Pages or Notebooks.

claims.claim: Disabling creation hides the Notebooks module in the Microsoft Copilot app.
claims.quote: the Notebooks module is hidden, preventing users from accessing existing Notebooks through the Copilot App.

claims.claim: Sharing links to Notebooks do not work when creation is disabled.
claims.quote: Sharing links to Copilot Notebooks don't work when creation is disabled via the policy in this article.

claims.claim: Disabling the policy does not delete existing Pages or Notebooks.
claims.quote: Existing Copilot Pages and Notebooks aren't deleted.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy changes can take up to 90 minutes when policy configurations already existed.
claims.quote: If there were existing policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 90 minutes to be reflected.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy changes can take up to 24 hours when no policy configurations previously existed.
claims.quote: If there were no policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 24 hours to be reflected.

claims.claim: Learn documents a two-group pattern to enable the policy only for a pilot subset.
claims.quote: Create Group A containing the users you want to enable the policy for ... Enabled. ... Create Group B that includes All users ... Disabled. ... Set the priority for Group A to a lower number

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: An audio overview turns the files in a Notebook into an audio summary.
claims.quote: Turn the files in your notebook into a dynamic audio overview for an engaging listening experience.

claims.claim: Notebook reference content can include files carrying sensitivity labels.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, and Copilot agents recognize and use the sensitivity labels that you apply to protect your organization's data.

claims.claim: Learn's compliance summary says sensitivity labels are available for Copilot Pages.
claims.quote: Sensitivity labels: Available for Copilot Pages.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Learn's compliance summary says Copilot Notebooks do not have container sensitivity labels.
claims.quote: Copilot Notebooks don't have container sensitivity labels because they share a container with all Copilot Pages.

claims.claim: The compliance summary gives sharing a container with all Copilot Pages as the reason for the lack of Notebook container labels.
claims.quote: Copilot Notebooks don't have container sensitivity labels because they share a container with all Copilot Pages.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Copilot checks usage rights for source items encrypted by sensitivity labels and returns their data only if the user has EXTRACT rights.
claims.quote: If the labels apply encryption from Microsoft Purview Information Protection, Copilot and agents check the usage rights for the user. Then, Copilot and agents return data from an item only if the user is granted permissions to copy (the EXTRACT usage right) from that item.

claims.claim: The cited Purview page documents label inheritance for Copilot in Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.
claims.quote: Copilot in Word, Copilot in PowerPoint, and Copilot in Outlook support sensitivity label inheritance for newly created content.

claims.claim: The cited Purview Copilot security page does not mention audio overview output.
claims.quote: Searched: audio overview sensitivity DLP; Copilot Notebooks labeled source files sensitivity labels references. Opened ai-m365-copilot and searched its full fetched text for audio, notebook and inheritance; inheritance is described for Word, PowerPoint and Outlook, not audio output.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Audio overview output label inheritance for these particular updates is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Notebooks audio overview sensitivity labels DLP output inheritance; labeled source files sensitivity labels references. Read Purview inheritance, sensitivity labels, compliance and release-note excerpts. General generated-file inheritance is described, but not this audio output case.

claims.claim: DLP behaviour specific to audio overview output is not described.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Notebooks audio overview output data loss prevention DLP supported file audio. Read compliance summary, ai-m365-copilot, DLP Copilot-location and Endpoint DLP excerpts. These describe broader rules and supported content, not audio overview output processing.

claims.claim: Learn says Conditional Access for Pages and Notebooks applies only at the entire Microsoft Copilot app level.
claims.quote: Conditional Access: Only applies at the app level. Because Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks are features of the Microsoft Copilot app, Conditional Access applies to the entire app at m365.cloud.microsoft.

claims.claim: Learn's compliance summary says Information Barriers are not supported for Copilot Pages and Notebooks.
claims.quote: Information Barriers are not supported for content stored in SharePoint Embedded containers. Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks use SharePoint Embedded for storage.

claims.claim: Learn's compliance summary says there is no end-user recycle bin.
claims.quote: Recycle bin: No end-user recycle bin exists.

claims.claim: The storage page instead says deleted Pages and Notebooks in OneDrive can be found in its recycle bin.
claims.quote: Deleted pages and notebooks can be found in the OneDrive recycle bin.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; Scope
claims.claim: The storage page distinguishes legacy items created before November 2025.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks created before November 2025 continue to be stored in the user-owned SharePoint Embedded container.

claims.claim: Learn says Copilot Pages require a OneDrive licence and an active OneDrive site.
claims.quote: Users need a OneDrive license and an active OneDrive site.

claims.claim: The compliance summary says Pages and Notebooks storage counts against the organisation's SharePoint quota.
claims.quote: Storage counts against your organization's SharePoint quota.

claims.claim: The storage page says current Pages and Notebooks count against the user's OneDrive storage limit.
claims.quote: Quota | Counts against user's OneDrive storage limit

claims.claim: Learn's compliance summary says Notebooks, Pages and Loop My workspace share a user-owned SharePoint Embedded container.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks are stored together in a single user-owned SharePoint Embedded container, which is also shared by Loop My workspace.

claims.claim: The storage page says current Pages and Notebooks are stored in OneDrive for Business.
claims.quote: Pages and Notebooks are stored in OneDrive for Business: the same visible file system where Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files live.

claims.claim: Learn says users with Exchange on-premises mailboxes have limited capabilities.
claims.quote: For full functionality including @mentions, users need an Exchange Online mailbox. Users with Exchange On-Premises mailboxes have limited capabilities.

claims.claim: Learn's September 3, 2025 release notes say users can save Notebook audio overviews to OneDrive.
claims.quote: Save an audio overview from Copilot Notebooks to OneDrive ... Save the audio overview that you have generated within a Copilot Notebook to OneDrive so you can download or share with others.

claims.claim: Audio overview files saved in OneDrive fall within the documented all-files retention scope for retention policies and labels.
claims.quote: All files stored in SharePoint (and SharePoint Embedded) or OneDrive sites can be retained by applying a retention policy or retention label.

claims.claim: Learn says Copilot Notebooks create and update .pod files.
claims.quote: Copilot Notebooks create and update .pod files to manage content.

claims.claim: Learn does not identify which additional content types this particular audio overview update will summarise.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Notebooks audio overview topic-based episodes labels roadmap 570966; Critique Debate. Read Notebooks requirements, storage, compliance and release notes. Other Notebook reference additions are documented, but none identifies the additional audio context types for this update.

claims.claim: The storage page reserves the SharePoint-quota statement for legacy Pages and Notebooks.
claims.quote: All legacy Copilot Pages and legacy Copilot Notebooks count against your organization's SharePoint storage quota.

claims.claim: Items created before November 2025 remain in the legacy SharePoint Embedded container.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks created before November 2025 continue to be stored in the user-owned SharePoint Embedded container. These legacy Copilot Pages and legacy Copilot Notebooks haven't moved to OneDrive for Business.
